coupling: The two edits are individually valid but encode conflicting invariants for the non-OpenDML audio index. The AVI bounds-fix commit allocates exactly nai[j] entries, which is correct when the parser treats nai[j] as the complete entry count. The later audio-tag bounds commit adds explicit sentinel initialization at audio_index[nai[j]], a valid operation only under the older nai[j]+1-entry allocation. Their composition turns that initialization into an out-of-bounds heap write. A reviewer must correlate allocation capacity with sentinel indexing across both commits: changing only the allocation shape or only the sentinel placement does not establish the shared invariant, and an isolated view of either maintenance change appears benign.
